items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: Vandora is mentioned only as a brand of reeds ('He much preferred the Vandora reeds than anything else').

ctx.x: I can't remember, but it was just almost directly across the street. It was in the 327, close to where the Royal Semester is now. And I lived at the Pontaubo building as soon as I got a salary, and had another close friend at Royal Arms who was in the refrigerator department, the name was Bennett D's. And then I shared 519, we lived at 519 St. Henn, first floor apartment, $45 a month. He paid $22.50 and I paid $22.50. And he was a great bathtub gin mixer, and we had lots of fun. Snoozer used to come down and play…
Well, I have a few little questions. I'd be glad if you would. Okay. Uh, we covered a lot of territory. Uh, what kind of reeds did Fahs use? You were talking about something? Vandora.

He liked them. He liked them. He, uh, he much preferred the Vandora reeds than anything else. And, uh, when he didn't have, uh, money to buy a box, well, I would pick out the very best reeds in the box for him. And, uh, at that time, uh, Fahs and Sal Franzella were very close. Well, I say friends. They were, uh, Fahs was a great, great jazz musician. And, uh, Sal Franzella was, uh, historically a tremendously well-trained saxophonist in China. He later played with Paul Whiteman. And, uh, New Orleans is full of…
